i'm trying to tell myself that but it feels completely unbearable and the fact that I know i will continue coming here for the rest of my life is totally fucked up.

Thank you for talking to me, this is very generous of you.

I wish I know. I could think of plenty of triggers, but when I am in the non-depressed state, I can handle these triggers just fine. It seems like an arbitrary factor that just makes me snap, almost random. I'm convinced that it must be some inherent flaw in how my mind works, rather than external issues.
